transform.scale_basis: #100 chosen 2.4 m floor-to-ceiling convention; not surveyed
transform.local_axis_mapping: Hunyuan -X to registered forward, +Y to camera right, +Z to camera up
transform.note: Convention placement for comparison only; no registration or calibration is accepted.

locked_traversal_gate.comparison_rule: route traversal metrics must match #135 using the same collision GLB and shared controller; any difference is a bug

visual_floor_ray.query: downward ray against Hunyuan visual geometry only; origin is 0.5 m above the authored collision floor and the 1.0 m cast spans 0.5 m above/below it; signed gap is visual hit Y minus authored collision floor Y
report: samples with no upward-facing floor surface at or below the collision floor within 0.5 m
visual holes: samples with no upward-facing floor surface within 0.5 m above or below the collision floor; a floor slightly above the plane is offset, not a hole
gap summaries grouped by distance from frame-141 camera
visual_floor_ray.acceptance: descriptive only; no pass/fail threshold because registration is uncalibrated

visual_capsule_intersection.query: test both Hunyuan visual layers against the controller capsule volume at every authored route sample; do not register visual geometry with Avian
visual_capsule_intersection.acceptance: descriptive only; no pass/fail threshold because visual geometry is uncalibrated

report: route simulation wall time and mean/p90/max Bevy update time

rendering.estimate_basis: #133 observed 4,229 MiB GPU peak and 6.58 GiB process RSS; estimates include margin and must be verified during an approved run

supplemental_godot_run.source_identity_check: Baseline corridor PLY, alignment manifest, scene, project settings and Gaussian compositor script hashes matched the main #100 worktree read-only.
